algorithms.name: Resilient Decentralized UCB (consistency filter + trimmed mean)

symbols.N_i: number of neighbors of agent i
symbols.f_byz: maximum number of Byzantine neighbors of an agent

conditions: regret of a single normal agent i

source.label: thm:lower
source.quote: The expected cumulative regret of any normal agent $i\in\scr H$ satisfies \liminf_{T\rightarrow\infty}\frac{R_i(T)}{\log T}\ge O\Big(\frac{\log T}{\max\{|\scr N_i|-2f+1,1\}}\Big).

results.notes: The statement is ill-formed: it puts O(.) on the right-hand side and log T inside a liminf. The proof concludes a lower bound of order Omega(log T / max{|N_i|-2f+1,1}), which is the expression recorded. The proof is an informal argument, not a rigorous change-of-measure construction.

symbols.G_ik: max_{t<=T} g_{i,k}(t) log t, where g_{i,k}(t) <= 1 is the algorithm's adjusted variance after filtering

conditions: regret of a single normal agent i

source.label: thm:complete
source.quote: The expected cumulative regret of any normal agent $i\in\scr H$ satisfies R_i(T) \le \min_{\tau\in\{1,\ldots,T\}}\Bigg(\sum_{k:\;\Delta_k>0}\bigg(\max_{t\in\{1,\ldots, \tau\}}\frac{8g_{i,k}(t)\log t}{\Delta_k}+\Big(1+\frac{\pi^2}{3}\Big)\Delta_k\bigg)+(T-\tau)\Delta_M\Bigg) \le \sum_{k:\;\Delta_k>0}\bigg(\max_{t\in\{1,\ldots, T\}}\frac{8g_{i,k}(t)\log t}{\Delta_k}+\Big(1+\frac{\pi^2}{3}\Big)\Delta_k\bigg).

results.notes: Only the looser second bound is recorded. The tighter form takes the min over tau and adds a term (T-tau)*Delta_max. The bound depends on the data-dependent quantity g_{i,k}(t).

conditions: regret of a single normal agent i

source.label: thm:noworse
source.quote: The regret for each normal agent $i\in\scr H$ is always no worse than that of the single-agent UCB1, i.e., R_i(T)\le\sum_{k:\;\Delta_k>0}\bigg(\frac{8\log T}{\Delta_k}+\Big(1+\frac{\pi^2}{3}\Big)\Delta_k\bigg).

results.notes: Regret is defined through arm means, so it is recorded as pseudo-regret.

conditions: each agent has at least 3f+1 neighbors
network regret summed over normal agents

source.label: thm:outperform
source.quote: If each agent has at least $3f+1$ neighbors, then the cumulative regret of all normal agents is strictly better than that of the non-cooperative counterpart: R(T)=\sum_{i\in\scr H} R_i(T)<|\scr H|\sum_{k:\;\Delta_k>0}\bigg(\frac{8\log T}{\Delta_k}+\Big(1+\frac{\pi^2}{3}\Big)\Delta_k\bigg).

results.notes: The inequality is strict. Remark 3 says the improvement is in the coefficient of log T.

symbols.p: probability that every agent has at least 3f+1 neighbors at a given time

conditions: random time-varying graphs where at each time every agent has at least 3f+1 neighbors with probability p in (0,1]
network regret summed over normal agents

source.label: thm:random
source.quote: If the probability that every agent in the network has at least $3f+1$ neighbors is $p\in(0,1]$ at each time $t$, then the network total regret is strictly better than the non-cooperative counterpart, i.e., \eqref{eq:better} holds.

results.notes: The inequality is strict. For p<1 the improvement is only O(1) (Remark 3).

symbols.N_i_max: max_t |N_i(t)|, the largest neighbor-set size of agent i over time

source.label: thm:tvlower
source.quote: For any time-varying neighbor graph sequence $\{\bbb G(t)\}$, the expected cumulative regret of any normal agent $i\in\scr H$ satisfies \liminf_{T\rightarrow\infty}\frac{R_i(T)}{\log T}\ge O\Big(\frac{\log T}{\max\{\max_{t}|\scr N_i(t)|-2f+1,1\}}\Big).

results.notes: The statement is ill-formed in the same way as Theorem 1. Interpreted as an Omega bound.

symbols.G_ik: max_{t<=T} g_{i,k}(t) log t (algorithm's adjusted variance times log t)
